title: Orbits and Fields of Definition for Graded Keller Maps
summary: We classify graded Keller maps by the signature of their weight vectors and address which hyperbolic weights support counterexamples and how the nonempty loci are stratified. We construct two families. Cyclic cones populate \(K(3,(1,-1,-1))\) at every composite generic fibre degree \(N\geq 6\), including a six-sheeted member over \(\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-15})\) and a 33-sheeted member over \(\mathbb{Q}\).
